title: FLIGHTED: Inferring fitness landscapes from noisy high-throughput experimental data.
authors: Sundar, Vikram; Tu, Boqiang; Guan, Lindsey; Esvelt, Kevin
one_liner_zh: 该文提出贝叶斯方法FLIGHTED，从噪声高通量实验数据推断蛋白质适应度景观，以提升蛋白质设计ML模型性能，虽不直接做结构计算，但适应度景观与蛋白质序列-功能关系紧密，方法可辅助结构相关设计任务。
abstract: Machine learning (ML) for protein design requires large protein fitness datasets generated by high-throughput experiments for training and benchmarking models. However, most models do not account for experimental noise inherent in these datasets, thereby harming model performance. Here, we develop fitness landscape inference generated by high-throughput experimental data (FLIGHTED), a Bayesian method of accounting for uncertainty by generating probabilistic fitness landscapes from noisy experiments. We demonstrate how FLIGHTED can improve model performance on two experiments: single-step selection assays, such as phage display, and a high-throughput assay that ties activity to base editing. We compare the performance of standard ML models on fitness landscapes with and without FLIGHTED. Accounting for noise statistically significantly improves model performance. Based on our new benchmarking with FLIGHTED, data size, not model scale, is limiting protein fitness model performance. Our results indicate that FLIGHTED can be applied to any high-throughput assay and any ML model, making it straightforward for protein designers to account for noise.
abstract_zh: 用于蛋白质设计的机器学习（ML）需要由高通量实验生成的大型蛋白质适应度数据集，以训练和基准测试模型。然而，大多数模型未考虑这些数据集中固有的实验噪声，从而损害了模型性能。在此，我们开发了由高通量实验数据生成的适应度景观推断（FLIGHTED），这是一种贝叶斯方法，通过从噪声实验中生成概率性适应度景观来考虑不确定性。我们展示了FLIGHTED如何改善两个实验中的模型性能：单步选择实验，如噬菌体展示，以及将活性与碱基编辑关联的高通量实验。我们比较了标准ML模型在有无FLIGHTED的适应度景观上的性能。考虑噪声在统计上显著提高了模型性能。基于我们使用FLIGHTED的新基准测试，数据规模而非模型规模限制了蛋白质适应度模型的性能。我们的结果表明，FLIGHTED可应用于任何高通量实验和任何ML模型，使蛋白质设计者能够直接考虑噪声。
